```{r setup, include=FALSE}

if (!require("pacman")) {
  install.packages("pacman")
  library(pacman)
} 
p_load(tidyverse,readxl,dplyr,stats,ggplot2,ggpubr)

png_path <- "../../results/targeted/"
```

# Set Up
```{r LoadDataset, echo=TRUE}
targeted = read_excel('../../doc/targeted/targeted_hormones.xlsx',sheet="DATA",range=NULL)

#convert sex column to factor
targeted$Sex <- as.factor(targeted$Sex)
targeted$`TT (ng/mL)`<- as.numeric(targeted$`TT (ng/mL)`)
targeted$`P4 (ng/mL)`<- as.numeric(targeted$`P4 (ng/mL)`)
targeted$`17B-E2 (ng/mL)`<- as.numeric(targeted$`17B-E2 (ng/mL)`)

#Load Functions
detect_outliers <- function(data, variable) {
  outlier_limit <- quantile(data[[variable]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5 * IQR(data[[variable]], na.rm = TRUE)
  outliers <- data %>% filter(.data[[variable]] > outlier_limit)
  data %>% filter(.data[[variable]] <= outlier_limit)
  print(outliers)
}
```
## Raw Data Distribution
```{r visualize_raw, echo=TRUE}
#convert sex column to factor and ensure hormone values are numeric
targeted$Sex <- as.factor(targeted$Sex)
targeted$`TT (ng/mL)`<- as.numeric(targeted$`TT (ng/mL)`)
targeted$`P4 (ng/mL)`<- as.numeric(targeted$`P4 (ng/mL)`)
targeted$`17B-E2 (ng/mL)`<- as.numeric(targeted$`17B-E2 (ng/mL)`)

#check distribution of hormones for normality
# Plot the distribution of TT (ng/mL) for the entire dataset
ggplot(targeted, aes(x = `TT (ng/mL)`)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.7, position = 'identity', bins = 30, fill = 'blue') +
  ggtitle('Distribution of TT (ng/mL) - Total') +
  xlab('TT (ng/mL)') +
  ylab('Count')
ggsave("tt_distribution.png", path = png_path)

# Check the distribution of TT (ng/mL) for normality by Sex
ggplot(targeted, aes(x = `TT (ng/mL)`, fill = Sex)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.7, position = 'identity', bins = 30) +
  facet_wrap(~ Sex) +
  ggtitle('Distribution of TT (ng/mL) by Sex') +
  xlab('TT (ng/mL)') +
  ylab('Count')
ggsave("tt_distribution_sex.png", path = png_path)

# Generate QQ plots
# QQ plot for total distribution
ggqqplot(targeted$`TT (ng/mL)`, ggtitle = "QQ Plot of TT (ng/mL) - Total")
ggsave("tt_QQ.png", path = png_path)
```

# Testosterone Analysis
```{r TT_SexComparison}

# Check the p-values
# If  > 0.05, we assume normality and can use a parametric test (t-test)
# Otherwise, use a non-parametric test (Wilcoxon rank-sum test)

if (all_shapiro_tt$p.value > 0.05) {
  # Perform t-test
  tt_t_test <- t.test(`TT (ng/mL)` ~ Sex, data = targeted)
  test_type <- "t-test"
  test_statistic <- tt_t_test$statistic
  p_value <- tt_t_test$p.value
  print(tt_t_test)
} else {
  # Perform Wilcoxon rank-sum test
  tt_wilcox_test <- wilcox.test(`TT (ng/mL)` ~ Sex, data = targeted)
  test_type <- "Wilcoxon rank-sum test"
  test_statistic <- tt_wilcox_test$statistic
  p_value <- tt_wilcox_test$p.value
  print(tt_wilcox_test)
}

# Visualize results with boxplot
ggboxplot(targeted, x = "Sex", y = "`TT (ng/mL)`",
          color = "Sex", 
          ylab = "TT (ng/mL)", xlab = "Sex",
          add = "jitter") +
  stat_compare_means(method = ifelse(all_shapiro_tt$p.value > 0.05, "t.test", "wilcox.test"),label = "p.format") +
  labs(title = paste(test_type, ": statistic =", round(test_statistic, 2)))
ggsave("tt_statistics_sex.png", path = png_path)

# Check the p-values
# If  > 0.05, we assume normality and can use a parametric test (t-test)
# Otherwise, use a non-parametric test (Wilcoxon rank-sum test)

if (clean_all_shapiro_tt$p.value > 0.05) {
  # Perform t-test
  clean_tt_t_test <- t.test(`TT (ng/mL)` ~ Sex, data = clean_targeted)
  test_type <- "t-test"
  test_statistic <- clean_tt_t_test$statistic
  p_value <- clean_tt_t_test$p.value
  print(clean_tt_t_test)
} else {
  # Perform Wilcoxon rank-sum test
  clean_tt_wilcox_test <- wilcox.test(`TT (ng/mL)` ~ Sex, data = clean_targeted)
  test_type <- "Wilcoxon rank-sum test"
  test_statistic <- clean_tt_wilcox_test$statistic
  p_value <- clean_tt_wilcox_test$p.value
  print(clean_tt_wilcox_test)
}

# Visualize results with boxplot
ggboxplot(clean_targeted, x = "Sex", y = "`TT (ng/mL)`",
          color = "Sex", 
          ylab = "TT (ng/mL)", xlab = "Sex",
          add = "jitter") +
  stat_compare_means(method = ifelse(clean_all_shapiro_tt$p.value > 0.05, "t.test", "wilcox.test"),label = "p.format") +
  labs(title = paste(test_type, ": statistic =", round(test_statistic, 2)))
ggsave("clean_tt_statistics_sex.png", path = png_path)

```
